text:
anu: build alert: mkdocs linkcheck failing for /api/embeddings -> missing anchor #create-embedding (used to be #Embeddings.create) hugo: yep. that one came from a migrated example where the heading was `Embeddings.create` (inline code) and mkdocs slugifies it differently than the old site. rebecca: quick mitigation: add an explicit HTML anchor for the old fragment so external links don't 404. small PR should be fine. anu: can we do the dual-anchor pattern? e.g. `

Creating embeddings

` to preserve legacy refs. hugo: done in branch docs/emb-anchor-compat. also normalized codeblock languages (ts -> typescript) while touching the file. separated into two commits. link-bot: Linkcheck output: ERROR /api/embeddings#Embeddings.create -> 404 anchor not found rebecca: thanks. include the linkcheck snippet in the PR description so reviewers can see the exact failure. hugo: pasted the snippet and requested a preview deploy. link-bot: Netlify preview started for branch docs/emb-anchor-compat (build 99333) anu: please also add a one-line note to CONTRIBUTING.md under "anchors" explaining when to preserve old fragments vs rename. keeps future PRs consistent. hugo: added blurb and a tiny example. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5012 rebecca: LGTM, linkcheck passes on preview. merging after CI green. link-bot: linkcheck PASS, markdownlint PASS hugo: merged. will follow up with a small infra task to add a linkcheck job to the nightly CI so we catch regressions earlier. anu: excellent, thanks team. closing thread.
